description: This file implements the HttpCache::Writers class, which manages reading, writing, and cache management for HTTP responses within a caching system. It handles transaction management, cache truncation, error handling, and coordination of network and cache operations.

classes.name: HttpCache::Writers::TransactionInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a specific HTTP transaction, including partial data, response info, and whether it is truncated.

classes.name: HttpCache::Writers
classes.description: Manages multiple HTTP transactions, coordinating reading, writing, cache truncation, error handling, and transaction priorities within the cache system.

classes.name: HttpCache::Writers::WaitingForRead
classes.description: Represents a transaction waiting for a read operation to complete, holding buffer, callback, and read length.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::Read
methods.description: Initiates a read operation for a transaction, handling ongoing reads and queuing if necessary.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::StopCaching
methods.description: Stops caching for the current transaction if it is the only one, optionally keeping the cache entry.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::AddTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new transaction to the cache writer, setting initial patterns, priority, and response info.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::SetNetworkTransaction
methods.description: Associates a network transaction with the writer, setting priority and checksum.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::ResetNetworkTransaction
methods.description: Resets the network transaction, typically when it is no longer needed.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::RemoveTransaction
methods.description: Removes a transaction from the writer, handling success or failure.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::EraseTransaction
methods.description: Erases a transaction from internal data structures, updating priorities and active transaction state.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::UpdatePriority
methods.description: Updates the highest priority among active transactions.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::CloseConnectionOnDestruction
methods.description: Closes the network connection if a network transaction exists.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::ContainsOnlyIdleWriters
methods.description: Checks if only idle (waiting) writers remain.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::CanAddWriters
methods.description: Determines if new writers can be added based on current patterns and states.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::ProcessFailure
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios, notifying waiting transactions and removing idle writers.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::TruncateEntry
methods.description: Truncates the cache entry response info if conditions are met.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::ShouldTruncate
methods.description: Decides whether the cache entry should be truncated based on headers and current size.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the network transaction.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::WaitingForRead::WaitingForRead
methods.description: Constructor for a transaction waiting for a read to complete.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing different states of read/write operations.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::DoNetworkRead
methods.description: Performs a network read operation.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::DoNetworkReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a network read.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::OnNetworkReadFailure
methods.description: Handles network read failure, triggering failure processing.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::DoCacheWriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the cache.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::DoCacheWriteDataComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of cache data write, updating checksum and transaction state.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::DoMarkSingleKeyedCacheEntryUnusable
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as unusable for a single key.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::DoMarkSingleKeyedCacheEntryUnusableComplete
methods.description: Completes marking a cache entry as unusable.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::OnDataReceived
methods.description: Processes data received from network or cache.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::OnCacheWriteFailure
methods.description: Handles failure during cache write.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::CompleteWaitingForReadTransactions
methods.description: Completes all transactions waiting for a read with the result.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::RemoveIdleWriters
methods.description: Removes idle transactions from the writer.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::SetCacheCallback
methods.description: Sets callback to be called when writing is done.

methods.name: HttpCache::Writers::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of I/O operations.
